domain: NIE, residence documents and visa thresholds

rules.statement: EX-15 is the NIE application form. EX-18 is the EU citizen registration certificate application and is a different procedure under RD 240/2007.

source.name: Policia Nacional sede electronica
source.ref: Asignacion de NIE a instancia de interesado

rules.notes: EX-18 is often given in error. The EX-15 form still carries an RD 557/2011 citation in its header even though RD 1155/2024 replaced it from 20 May 2025; the form remains in use.

rules.statement: The tasa for assignment of a NIE is 9.84 euros.

source.name: BOE consolidated text
source.ref: Orden PJC/617/2025 de 13 de junio, annex 5.12, in force 16 June 2025

rules.notes: Related fees from the same annex: certificado de residente or no residente 7.31; certificado de registro de ciudadano de la UE 12.00; TIE first temporary residence 16.08, renewal 19.30, long-term 21.87, family member of a Spanish national 12.00. The 790/012 form covers many procedures at different prices, so select the fee by procedure, not by form number.

rules.statement: The NIE number is personal, unique and sequential. The certificate that carries it is what expires: a certificado de no residente is valid three months from issue.
rules.notes: PARTIAL: art. 205 RD 1155/2024 could not be read verbatim, so the absence of an expiry provision is strong but not an express rule. SAFE PUBLIC WORDING: 'Your NIE number stays with you. The certificate that proves it is only accepted for three months, so banks, notaries and tax offices may ask for a fresh one.' Never say 'the NIE expires'.

rules.statement: The non-lucrative residence visa requires 400 percent of IPREM for the main applicant and 100 percent of IPREM per dependant.

source.name: Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores
source.ref: Visado de residencia no lucrativa, consular requirements

rules.notes: IPREM has been frozen at 600 euros a month since Ley 31/2022 through successive budget prorogas, and SEPE still publishes 600 monthly / 7,200 annual. No 2026 instrument fixing IPREM was found. Re-check every January. The 8,400 annual IPREM variant, used where a rule refers to the SMI in annual terms, was not verified.

rules.statement: The international teleworking visa requires 200 percent of the SMI monthly, plus 75 percent of SMI for a second household member and 25 percent per additional member.

source.name: Ministerio de Inclusion
source.ref: Instruccion conjunta sobre teletrabajadores de caracter internacional

rules.notes: DO NOT PUBLISH A EURO FIGURE. The Instruccion says 200 percent of the SMI monthly but does not state whether the base is the 12-payment monthly figure or the annual figure divided by twelve. The two readings give roughly 2,442 and 2,849 euros a month. State the rule as '200 percent of the Spanish minimum wage' and link to the SMI. SMI 2026 set by RD 126/2026: 40.70 per day, 1,221 per month in 14 payments, 17,094 per year.

rules.statement: The investor residence route closed to new applications on 3 April 2025.

source.name: BOE consolidated text
source.ref: Ley Organica 1/2025, emptying arts. 63 to 67 of Ley 14/2013

rules.notes: This closed the WHOLE investor route, not only the property variant. Applications filed before 3 April 2025 continue under the old rules; existing authorisations keep their validity; renewals are decided under the law in force when the original permit was granted. Dates of April 2024 and April 2025 are both circulating. 3 April 2025 is the correct one, and the investment threshold was denominated in euros, not dollars.
